queries: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.circuitId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.circuitId), country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(ra.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(ra.avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN race_averages AS ra ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_difference FROM country_averages ORDER BY country;

WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT countries.country, AVG(ra.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(ra.avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country FROM circuits) AS countries LEFT JOIN race_averages AS ra ON ra.country IS countries.country GROUP BY countries.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Every country in circuits is included, even if none of its circuits has a recorded race; its averages are then NULL.
